Upper Text: When you would play this card, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each placed card reduces the play cost.The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [OmniShoutmon] and [ZeigGreymon].
[On Play] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 8000 DP or less. 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't attack until the end of their turn.
[End of Attack] By deleting this Digimon, gain 1 memory.
